questions.question_text: What is tinfoil used for in photography?
questions.sample_answer: To reduce glare from camera lens

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of electrolysis in terms of its relation to electrochemical cells.
questions.sample_answer: Electrolysis is the process of using an electric current to drive a chemical reaction, often used to split a molecule into its constituent elements. This occurs due to the difference in potential between the electrodes, which causes the transfer of electrons and drives the reaction forward.
expected_points: Electric current driving a chemical reaction
